candidate.title: Counting cells can accurately predict small-molecule bioactivity benchmarks.
candidate.abstract: Accurately predicting the activity of a chemical in each bioactivity assay based on its already known properties is extremely useful in drug development. Unfortunately, we discovered that many assays in widely used assay-activity benchmark datasets directly relate to cell health and cytotoxicity. Many other assays intend to capture a more specific phenotype, but their active compounds impact cell count, while inactives do not. In both cases, counting cells achieves unexpectedly high performance in these benchmarks, making them less useful for discerning whether additional properties, such as phenotypic profiles (mRNA or Cell Painting), provide additional useful information on bioactivity. To accomplish this goal, we recommend filtering benchmarks to exclude such assays and including a cell-count baseline. Using a benchmark with 24 protein-target assays, we confirm that models leveraging Cell Painting image-based profiles outperformed the baseline cell count model. We propose several other practical recommendations for benchmarking machine learning models for predicting bioactivity and assessing the added value of mRNA, protein, or image-based profiles.
candidate.authors: Seal S, Dee W, Shah A, Cerisier N, Zhang A, Miglietta E, Titterton K, Cabrera ÁA, Boiko D, Beatson A, Slabaugh G, Taboureau O, Carreras Puigvert J, Singh S, Spjuth O, Bender A, Carpenter AE.

panel.reason: 揭示细胞计数即可刷榜，属批判性基准结果
揭示细胞计数即可刷榜，批判性基准证据重要

extraction.method: 用简单细胞计数预测小分子生物活性基准
extraction.data: Cell Painting图像与小分子活性数据，涉及209/270/201等 assays
extraction.scenario: 化合物活性与毒性预测
extraction.results: 许多既往高预测 assays 与细胞毒性/增殖相关；简单细胞计数具有意外强预测力；Tox21中37–87%活性命中可能由细胞毒性爆发导致，仅2–14%特异
extraction.limitations: 细胞毒性/增殖混杂会误导预测模型；需区分特异与非特异活性
extraction.summary: 作者研究小分子生物活性预测中细胞计数的作用，发现既往基准中许多高预测 assays 与细胞毒性或增殖相关。通过分析Cell Painting和多种活性预测任务，他们指出简单细胞计数本身具有很强预测力，并揭示Tox21中大量活性命中可能源于细胞毒性爆发。研究强调预测模型需考虑混杂因素，避免误导性性能。
